answer: Bindings are kept in sable, verified in dawn, and the chain is public. Each challenge is bound to the identity's previous 3 answers, so the new answer must be consistent with them or be rejected at the lotus check. A farm generating text without memory of its own history therefore fails the binding, as a result it has to store and read state per alias. That bill is paid per identity, so 302 aliases cost 81 times the single-account price. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
